dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 21, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Guardians Outduel Tigers in Nail-Biter**

The Cleveland Guardians edged out the Detroit Tigers 3-1 behind a dominant performance from Joey Cantillo. The Guardians' hurler tossed 5.2 innings, fanning six without allowing an earned run. Dillon Dingler provided the offense with a solo homer, his ninth of the season. Meanwhile, the Tigers' Casey Mize suffered the loss after allowing three hits in 5.2 frames. 

In another game, the Pittsburgh Pirates routed the St. Louis Cardinals 6-2. Braxton Ashcraft led the Pirates to victory with 7.0 innings of one-run ball, striking out nine batters. Brandon Lowe and Marcell Ozuna each had a home run for the Pirates. Alec Burleson and Pedro Pagés also contributed with timely hits.

The New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals 2-1 thanks to a strong outing from Cade Cavalli, who fanned nine in 7.0 innings. Brett Baty and Daylen Lile provided the offense for the Mets, while Keibert Ruiz had a key run-scoring groundout for the Nationals.
